tbesh_html:
1) javelin, short sword, dart
2) gorget, a piece of armour for the throat (1Sa 17.6)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart
strongs_1890.derivation: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית)
